cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor nsid maddress" "ip netns add c1del && ip netns set c1del 7 && ip netns del c1del" "^nsid 7 " "^Deleted nsid 7 "
desc: positive: an nsid's whole life, added, assigned 7 and deleted, under a monitor
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up
